attribution.why: A side effect of the fix. The added rule says to locate store-closure causes at the merchant; in all 3 trials the agent also located this refund rise at a merchant (茶饮咖啡连锁A) inside the planted 深圳 × 茶饮咖啡 cell, and in two trials named a second cause beside it. Base got this task right in 2 of 3.
attribution.fix: Keep the merchant rule to store closures in code (the lever decides the grain), or add to the rule that other levers stop at the segment where the change is spread; re-run B09 and the other refund tasks.
